label: Interactive media
tagline: TouchDesigner-flavoured pieces the user drives with body or device
description: Orchestrates a generative interactive piece where the user's body/device (mic, camera, mouse, gyro, MIDI, gamepad) becomes a creative material and the output is real-time generative response (shader, particles, 3D, audio). Runs 5-researcher fleet + synthesiser; user-steerage interrupt before any drawer fires; §8.3 loop-until-bar; multi-draft at mapping + runtime + output cruxes; §8.5 cross-drawer coherence review before final commit. Permission UX gates camera/mic via two-gate pattern (canvas-side + iframe-side Start). Two cross-boundary contracts the orchestrator enforces beyond the per-drawer lens trios: §1.2 iframe ↔ host pointer + scroll contract (touch-action policy honest about declared inputs, Start-gate release after gating, allow= attribute coverage, scroll-past affordance for hero-slot pointer-input pieces) and §5.6 Phase F layered-interaction QA + fix pass the chat caller runs after Step-8 QA — catches Start-gate splash forgetting to release pointer-events, getUserMedia double-prompts, allow= attribute mismatches.

triggers.title: build an app with this piece
triggers.rule: User wants the interactive piece embedded in an app. Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell (with im-placeholder slot + allow= attribute), then dispatches interactive-media-orchestrator per slot (). After hand-off, Claude drives the build per simulation-orchestrator.md §5.1.0 (same shape + §8.5 coherence) and embeds the runtime.
